title: Search Mechanics
summary: improve the separate domain-owned search systems, beginning with full-text retrieval for the rationalised Studio documentation corpus
content_html:
Search Mechanics

Refine index inclusion, ranking, result context, and efficiency while retaining the current separate Catalogue and Docs Viewer static-search structure.

Feature Documents

  • SM-1 — Studio Full-Text Search Delivery — clean the Studio index inputs and add document-level title, heading, body, and code retrieval.
  • Search — current architecture and known weak spots.

Studio Documentation Maintenance rationalises the Studio corpus and adds exact same-scope backlink visibility before SM-1 begins. SM-1 changes only Docs Viewer search with a Studio-scoped first adoption; Catalogue Search remains a separate later mechanics delivery.
